book.scene: Fourteen drawings, a few words to talk about on every page, and one empty page for the ending your child draws. One page a night at the kitchen table.
book.materials: Printed on FSC-certified, acid-free, uncoated paper with a light texture made for pencils and crayons. Matte laminated cover. Glued spine with PUR, the strong, flexible glue used in bookshop paperbacks. Printed to order near you, in France, the UK, the US or Canada.
inside: A welcome page with a QR code to send Pim your child’s ending
14 drawings to colour, each on a right-hand page
A short conversation guide for the grown-up facing every drawing: one question or one good word
One empty last page where your child draws the ending
book.care: Best with pencils and crayons. Thick markers can show through, so every drawing sits on a right-hand page.
book.safety: For colouring with a grown-up nearby. Keep the packaging away from children.

poster.scene: Some of the picture is already in colour; the rest is waiting for your child. Finish it together, then frame it and hang it on the wall.
poster.materials: Printed on matte paper, 189 g/m² and 0.26 mm thick, with no shine, so it is easy to frame. Printed to order near you and shipped rolled in a tube. 70 × 100 cm is a standard frame size.
poster.care: Colour with pencils, crayons or felt-tips. Put a sheet of card under the poster when you use felt-tips. Lay it flat under a few books for a day after unrolling.
poster.safety: Keep the tube and the packaging away from small children.

mug.scene: For the grown-up who reads the story every night. Pim’s cup for the morning coffee.
mug.materials: White glazed ceramic, 330 ml. The print wraps around the mug. The colour-inside version has a glazed coloured inside and handle. Made to order in Europe or the US, near you.
mug.care: Dishwasher and microwave safe. Hand washing keeps the print bright for longer.
mug.safety: For hot drinks: take care with small children nearby.

tote.scene: The grown-up’s bag: the book, the crayons, the spare socks, the library trip. Carry the story.
facts: Straps 62 cm, fits on the shoulder
tote.materials: 100% organic cotton twill, 272 g/m², with GOTS and OCS certified organic cotton, and OEKO-TEX certified fabric. Printed with water-based inks. Made to order in Printful’s own sewing and print shops in Latvia, Spain, the UK, the US or Canada.
tote.care: Wash at 30°C inside out. Do not iron on the print. Do not tumble dry.
tote.safety: Not a toy. Keep the straps away from small children.

postcards.scene: Ten cards, one design. Write a line on the back and send it to Grandma.
postcards.materials: Matte uncoated card, 300 g/m², FSC certified. Rounded corners. The back has space for a message and an address. Printed to order near you.
postcards.care: Write with a pen or a pencil. Ballpoint and felt-tip both work on the matte back.
postcards.safety: Keep the packaging away from small children.

cards.scene: Ten cards with Pim’s world on the front, with envelopes. Blank inside, for your own words.
facts: Pack of 10, one design, with envelopes
Matte card, FSC certified, blank inside
cards.materials: Folded matte card, FSC certified, square corners. Comes with 10 envelopes: premium recycled envelopes in the EU, standard envelopes elsewhere. Printed to order near you.
cards.care: Blank inside for your own words. Write with any pen.
cards.safety: Keep the packaging away from small children.

delivery: Made to order and printed in your region. EU 3–10 working days, US, UK and Canada 3–7 working days. Unused items can be returned within 14 days. If it arrives damaged or wrong, we replace it.
separateParcel: Each printer sends its own parcel, so an order with a book and a poster arrives in two parcels.

trust.t: Made to order near you: France, the UK, the US or Canada for books; Europe or North America for everything else.
FSC paper, GOTS organic cotton, OEKO-TEX fabric. Each claim sits next to its certificate on Our materials.
Every story is created by the Telning team of cognitive and behavioural scientists, and designed in Sweden.
